exception_categories.title: Missing HRIS join record
exception_categories.description: A payroll-side in-scope worker/earning record cannot be joined to an HRIS worker/assignment/position record using the approved linkage keys/crosswalks for the run.
exception_categories.required_resolution_path: Investigate linkage keys and HRIS extract completeness; correct crosswalk or extract; rerun join integrity reconciliation; disposition recorded in Validation Charter decision log if residual risk accepted.
exception_categories.evidence_required: Join integrity report showing orphan counts by key; extract metadata; corrected crosswalk/version reference; rerun comparison evidence.
exception_categories.notes: Default posture is fail-closed for in-scope records. Use together with JOIN_DUPLICATE_KEY if duplicates contribute.

exception_categories.title: Missing payroll join record
exception_categories.description: An HRIS-side in-scope worker/assignment record cannot be joined to payroll worker/earning records for the defined pay period/run within the pilot perimeter.
exception_categories.required_resolution_path: Confirm payroll extract perimeter and period alignment; validate payroll_worker_id linkage; correct payroll extract or crosswalk; rerun join integrity reconciliation.
exception_categories.evidence_required: Join integrity report; payroll extract metadata; evidence of period/run inclusion; rerun evidence.
exception_categories.notes: May indicate population scope mismatch or period mismatch; consider PERIOD_MISMATCH as secondary code.

exception_categories.title: Duplicate key / cardinality breach
exception_categories.description: A required key that must be unique within its reconciliation grain appears more than once (or join cardinality deviates from the declared expectation), creating ambiguous linkage and potential double-counting.
exception_categories.required_resolution_path: Identify duplicate source records or mapping duplication; resolve by correcting upstream data, crosswalk, or extraction filters; rerun join and control totals reconciliation; obtain Payroll/HRIS owner acknowledgement if data correction is outside platform control.
exception_categories.evidence_required: Duplicate key report with affected identifiers; root-cause analysis; corrected extract/crosswalk reference; rerun evidence showing duplicates resolved.
exception_categories.notes: Ambiguous joins are non-defensible for worker-level explainability and payroll anchoring.

exception_categories.title: Unmapped earning code
exception_categories.description: A payroll earning code present in in-scope earning lines does not have an approved mapping to a canonical remuneration component (base/variable/allowance/other), risking silent pay leakage or misstatement.
exception_categories.required_resolution_path: Classify the earning code under payroll controls; update controlled mapping (new mapping version) or explicitly exclude with coded rationale and approval; rerun component-level and totals reconciliation.
exception_categories.evidence_required: Earning-code coverage report; mapping table version before/after; approval record for mapping change or exclusion; rerun evidence with code resolved.
exception_categories.notes: Mapping changes must be versioned and auditable (SoT Matrix `pay_component_mapping_version`).

exception_categories.title: Earning code misclassified
exception_categories.description: A payroll earning code is mapped, but to the wrong canonical component (e.g., base vs variable), causing component misstatement even if total remuneration may still reconcile.
exception_categories.required_resolution_path: Confirm payroll semantic meaning of earning code; correct mapping and bump mapping version; rerun component-level reconciliation; confirm any downstream metric inputs impacted.
exception_categories.evidence_required: Payroll earning code definition evidence; mapping correction diff; mapping approval record; rerun component-level residual report.
exception_categories.notes: This is critical for bonus/variable pay metrics and explainability even if aggregates appear within tolerance.

exception_categories.title: Currency mismatch / inconsistent currency context
exception_categories.description: Currency codes are missing, invalid, or inconsistent within a reconciliation grain where monetary comparisons require a stable currency context.
exception_categories.required_resolution_path: Validate currency extraction and canonicalization; correct missing/invalid codes; ensure monetary comparisons are performed within the correct currency context; rerun affected reconciliations.
exception_categories.evidence_required: Currency validation report; extract metadata; corrected records; rerun evidence.
exception_categories.notes: Currency conversion rules are out of scope for v1; if conversion is required it must be explicitly governed before use.

exception_categories.title: Pay period mismatch / calendar misalignment
exception_categories.description: Pay period boundaries, period identifiers, or payroll run allocation do not align between extracts or do not match the payroll calendar, creating mis-scoped inclusion and invalid comparisons.
exception_categories.required_resolution_path: Confirm payroll calendar definitions for the pilot; correct extract period scoping; ensure off-cycle runs are explicitly flagged and allocated per policy; rerun reconciliation with corrected perimeter.
exception_categories.evidence_required: Payroll calendar reference; extract period metadata; off-cycle/run allocation evidence; rerun evidence.
exception_categories.notes: Often co-occurs with OFFCYCLE_RUN or RETRO_PAY_TREATMENT.

exception_categories.title: FTE fraction mismatch
exception_categories.description: FTE fraction values between HRIS (primary SoR) and payroll-derived equivalents differ beyond the allowed tolerance for in-scope workers, risking incorrect normalization.
exception_categories.required_resolution_path: Validate HRIS FTE and payroll standard-hours inputs; correct source data or mapping; rerun normalization-input reconciliation; document accepted residual risk only via decision log entry if permitted.
exception_categories.evidence_required: FTE comparison report with deltas; source field lineage; corrected source/mapping reference; rerun evidence.
exception_categories.notes: Aligned to SoT Matrix tolerance for `fte_fraction` (abs diff <= 0.01 unless justified).

exception_categories.title: Hours mismatch
exception_categories.description: Paid/standard hours inputs (where used) do not reconcile across sources or do not sum to expected totals within tolerance, risking incorrect hourly normalization or eligibility decisions.
exception_categories.required_resolution_path: Confirm whether hours are in scope and used for computations; if used, resolve source discrepancies and rerun; if not used, record as warning with explicit risk acceptance and ensure it does not drive outputs.
exception_categories.evidence_required: Hours comparison report; statement of whether hours are used in the pilot computations; disposition approval for warning acceptance.
exception_categories.notes: May be escalated to BLOCKER when hours are pilot-mandatory and used for metrics normalization.

exception_categories.title: Retro pay treatment ambiguity or misallocation
exception_categories.description: Retroactive pay adjustments are present but are not allocated to the correct period/run or are treated inconsistently across reconciliations, causing totals mismatches or misleading period attribution.
exception_categories.required_resolution_path: Define and apply a retro allocation rule for the pilot perimeter; ensure retro lines are flagged and allocated consistently; rerun worker-level and aggregate reconciliation; document any allowed residual risk.
exception_categories.evidence_required: Payroll retro indicator evidence; allocation rule reference; before/after reconciliation residuals; rerun evidence.
exception_categories.notes: Retro handling must remain payroll-anchored; do not infer retro treatment from non-payroll sources.

exception_categories.title: Off-cycle payroll run present / mis-scoped
exception_categories.description: An off-cycle payroll run is present and either not included/excluded consistently with pilot scope, or is not correctly identified and allocated, impacting reconciliation and period scoping.
exception_categories.required_resolution_path: Confirm off-cycle inclusion policy for pilot scope; validate off_cycle_flag and payroll_run_id coverage; correct extracts and rerun reconciliation with explicit off-cycle segmentation.
exception_categories.evidence_required: Payroll run inventory for period; off_cycle_flag completeness report; reconciliation rerun evidence segmented by run type.
exception_categories.notes: Off-cycle handling is a frequent source of aggregate deltas; must be visible in evidence.

exception_categories.title: Manual payroll adjustment present
exception_categories.description: Payroll earning lines indicate manual adjustments (or non-standard corrections) that require explicit identification, classification, and disposition to maintain defensibility and reproducibility.
exception_categories.required_resolution_path: Review manual adjustment lines; confirm they are legitimate and correctly classified; if material or causes out-of-tolerance deltas, resolve and rerun; otherwise record warning with explicit approval and evidence.
exception_categories.evidence_required: List of manual adjustment lines; payroll controls sign-off; impact assessment on totals and components; disposition record.
exception_categories.notes: Escalate to BLOCKER when manual adjustments materially affect pilot-mandatory remuneration fields beyond tolerance.

exception_categories.title: Aggregate control totals mismatch
exception_categories.description: Entity/period aggregate control totals derived from reconciled records do not match payroll control totals within tolerance, indicating potential leakage, mis-scoping, or mapping issues.
exception_categories.required_resolution_path: Perform drill-down from aggregates to worker/component; identify root cause (unmapped codes, period misalignment, join leakage, duplicates); correct and rerun until within tolerance or formally disposition with decision log entry (rare).
exception_categories.evidence_required: Aggregate totals report; drill-down residual analysis; linked exception codes for underlying causes; rerun evidence with corrected totals.
exception_categories.notes: This code is often secondary; primary cause codes (e.g., EARNING_CODE_UNMAPPED) should be recorded alongside.
